scope: cmux-tui/crates/cmux-tui-core/src, *.rs, no tests/ directory, no *_tests.rs: every `ghostty_vt::` (the Q15 query) and every parser lock: `.term.lock(`, `.term.try_lock(`, `.term.slot.lock(`, `.term.slot.try_lock(`, every read of a terminal's input modes: `.input_modes(`, `.input_modes.load(`, `.key_encoder(`, and each call of a parser accessor (a function whose signature hands a closure the Terminal, found in the scanned code, or the item of an `accessor` row): `with_terminal(`, `try_with_terminal(`, `try_with_hot_terminal(`, `with_terminal_stream_update(`, `discard_unreplayable_replay_with(`

classes.page: reads a value the VT worker publishes in its seqlock screen page; no hop, safe on the key path (tasks 133, 209)
classes.async: reads parser state too large or too rare for the page (replays, snapshots, history, Kitty images); with process workers an asynchronous request to the shard owner, never on a key path (task 135)
classes.in-worker: runs where the parser runs (construction, byte feed, parser callbacks, frame builds, viewport and resize changes); moves into the worker, and the daemon sends it a command
classes.dead: the daemon reads no parser state here: test code, a doc comment, a compile-time constant, a type, or formatting of a value another row read

async_paths.request: a socket, CLI, resource or attach request waits for it (p01-process risk 8 counts these rows)
async_paths.background: daemon background work: journal checkpoint, archive, memory pass, persistence, respawn pre-fill, rehost
async_paths.accessor: a generic parser accessor; its callers are rows of their own

page_fields.screen.generation: content generation, stream revision and parsed offset, advanced after each parse slice; waiters sleep on it
page_fields.screen.cells: the visible rows: text, styles and the damage list (what viewport_text and a frame build read)
page_fields.screen.cursor: cursor position, visibility (DECTCEM), shape and blink
page_fields.modes.keyboard: Kitty keyboard flag stack, DECCKM, DECKPAM and modifyOtherKeys: what KeyEncoder::sync_from_terminal reads
page_fields.modes.mouse: mouse tracking and format and the pointer semantic snapshot: what MouseEncoders::sync_from_terminal reads
page_fields.modes.input_word: the InputModes word (InputModes::to_word): every mode above, published in one atomic word after each parse under the terminal lock, or from the VT worker page header (PageReader::read_modes); key, paste, focus and mouse encoders load it with no lock (task 209)
page_fields.metadata.osc_progress: OSC 9;4 progress state the parser callbacks set; published in the same seqlock generation as screen.cells, so a reader gets text and progress from one parse cut
